interface.alias_and_mutation_notes: Returns intermediate FP8 states plus sorted E8M0 scales. The first-component call wrapper and whole-tuple correctness probe have distinct surfaces.

contracts.value: grouped per-expert GEMM + routing: out[t,k,:] = quant_fp8( silu(gate)*up ) where [gate|up] = a[t,:] @ w1[e(t,k)]^T (mxfp8 act x mxfp4 weights, e8m0 block scales), scattered by the moe_sorting block map; returns (inter_states_fp8, out_scale_sorted_e8m0)

oracle_component_note.value: The seam returns (inter_states_fp8, out_scale_sorted_e8m0). ONLY component 0 is value-gated: it is bit-exact vs the frozen capture and vs the live baseline on every random draw. Component 1 (out_scale_sorted) is a torch.empty SCRATCH buffer written only over the computed tiles; measured on this box it is uninitialized (e8m0 0xFF=NaN) outside them, differs between two consecutive BASELINE calls even at the real sorted slots, and the captured copy does not reproduce at all (decode: recorded median exponent 0 vs live 116). Value-gating it fails the live baseline against itself, so unittest.py gates it structurally (arity/dtype/shape) only. The scales are still constrained indirectly and exactly: component 0 is the fp8 mantissa of the same product, so any change of block scale moves the mantissas and is caught; the e2e output-parity gate covers the rest.

dynamic_dimensions.policy: Only dimensions explicitly instantiated by the protected builders are catalogued. Random value draws do not create additional shapes. Routing lengths, live split counts, sparse indices, and physical oracle strides remain runtime data where not recorded.

case_id_and_shape_recipes.docstring:
FRESH random ACTIVATION values at the FIXED captured dims (dims are never randomized).

Only `hidden_states` is redrawn. The expert weights/scales stay as captured because random e8m0
exponents / fp4 bit patterns are not an in-regime distribution, and every routing tensor stays as
captured because MoE routing is value-dependent and must never be fabricated.
